title: Support for Employers to Better Manage Remote and Hybrid Work Teams
what_it_is: Support for Employers to Better Manage Remote and Hybrid Work Teams

sections.label: Employers assess remote work suitability
sections.summary: MOM and Tripartite Partners support companies implementing remote and flexible work, with employers assessing suitable work types and implementation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM and our Tripartite Partners take a practical approach towards supporting companies that are implementing remote work and other forms of flexible work arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Specifically on remote work, employers are best placed to assess what types of work in the company are suitable for this form of flexible work arrangement, how best to implement it, retain their employees and motivate them, while ensuring the needs of the business are met.

sections.label: Government support and fair assessment
sections.summary: Government supports via Productivity Solutions Grant; TAFEP advises employees facing unfair treatment, and fair assessment principles remain unchanged.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Government supports them through the Productivity Solutions Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, the Institute for Human Resource Professionals developed a Playbook on Hybrid Workplaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employees who experience unfair treatment, including in performance assessment while on remote-work arrangements, can reach out to the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) for advice and assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Remote work may be an emerging workplace practice, but the principle of fair and objective assessment remains unchanged.

sections.label: Funding support for remote work
sections.summary: Government recognises some companies need help implementing remote work and flexible arrangements, with Productivity Solutions Grants available for technology funding.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The Government recognises that some companies may need help in implementing remote work and other forms flexible work arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On the subject of supporting companies that might need some funding support to acquire technologies to implement remote work, we do have the Productivity Solutions Grants for companies to consider.
